ITEM 1 | Round, bagel-like piece about 9 cm across with a pale golden-tan outer crust and a hole in the center; the top is covered by a thick, opaque, off-white spread with a creamy, slightly textured surface and small flecks of green and darker herbs visible; spread is matte with little sheen and holds its mound shape, sitting in the lower-right area of the plate | 110

ITEM 2 | Thick, opaque, off-white creamy spread (cream cheese-like) layered over the top of the round piece, about 7 cm across and roughly 1.5 cm high at its mound, with a soft, smooth-to-lumpy surface, small darker flecks scattered through it, and a slightly glossy sheen; it sits on top of item 1 and holds its shape | 45
